# Paper Review Template (10 questions)

Dùng cho `02_References/Reading_Notes/` và `docs/weekly/W02/SVx_Paper_Review.md`.

## Bibliographic fields

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Title | |
| **Author(s)** | |
| **Year** | |
| **Venue** | |
| DOI / URL | |
| Reviewer | SV1 / SV2 / SV3 / SV4 |

## Ten questions

1. **What problem does this paper address?**
2. **What method or architecture is proposed?**
3. **Which datasets and metrics are used?**
4. **What are the main quantitative results?**
5. **What are the limitations and assumptions?**
6. **How does this relate to VQA, VLMs, OCR, PEFT, or Vietnamese NLP?**
7. **How reproducible is the work (code, seeds, checkpoints)?**
8. **Can we run a related idea under PEFT-only (LoRA/QLoRA 4/8-bit) on Colab Pro/Premium or the university GPU?**
9. **What risks (VRAM, licence, hallucination, English-only tokenization) if we adopt it?**
10. **What can we learn / use for our project?** ← **BẮT BUỘC**

## Optional wrap-up

- One-row contribution to `docs/weekly/W02/Literature_Matrix.md`
- Follow-up experiment idea (W08–W12) or *not applicable*
